offlineAuthoritativeReceiptSubphase.scope: Offline authoritative receipt persistence, revocation invalidation and runtime evidence revalidation only. No production composition or external browser/network effect.

verification.focusedTests: offline composition and direct runtime dependencies: 7 files, 34/34

canonicalCheckpoint.note: The authoritative receipt dependency closure and the bounded offline main composition are now integrated. The composition injects Electron safeStorage and only the Marketplace completed-receipt sink; no production browser driver, connector or network effect is registered.

offlineProductionCompositionSubphase.scope: Electron safeStorage injection, encrypted authority-store construction and Marketplace completed-receipt sink composition only. No driver, browser, connector or network effect.

dependencyProvenanceGate.evidence: Exact package integrity, Apache-2.0 license, pnpm content-addressed store entries, materialized package metadata, browsers.json mapping and a complete SHA-256-pinned Chromium executable were verified offline.
dependencyProvenanceGate.decision: No package lease, lockfile edit, install or production driver registration until dependency installation/package writes are explicitly authorized.

webSocketAuthorityDecision.scope: Personal Office managed browser runtime only
webSocketAuthorityDecision.consumerInventory: No accepted Marketplace, IntegrationGrant, Work, workspace-blueprint or v1 product workflow declares or requires ws/wss. BrowserRuntimeSpec contains no socket authority.
webSocketAuthorityDecision.enforcement: The managed driver keeps deny-all routeWebSocket handling. HTTP origin approval and the separate .ocx net.websocket capability do not grant browser-runtime socket authority.
webSocketAuthorityDecision.reopenRule: A future concrete socket consumer requires a new contract change request, security model, tests, independent review and exact-path lease before implementation.
